summary: With the adoption of the Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, which aims to improve safety across our city using a data-driven and targeted approach, there has been an increase in requests to reduce the speed limit around school zones in Ward 13. Local residents, school administration, trustees and parent councils have all expressed support for the adoption of a 30km/hour speed limit in school zones in attempt to reduce traffic-related deaths and injuries to ZERO. St Cecilia Catholic Elementary School, Annette Street Junior and Senior Public School, High Park Alternative Junior School Clendenan Avenue Clendenan Avenue, which runs from Bloor Street West to Dundas Street West, is a local road with two‐way operation and sidewalks on both sides of the road. The legal speed limit on Clendenan Avenue between Bloor Street West and Dundas Street West is 40 km/hr. I am requesting that the speed limit on Clendenan Avenue from Annette Street to Glendowynne Road be reduced to 30 km/hr. This section of the street has three schools, Annette Street Junior and Senior Public School, High Park Alternative Junior School and Humberside C.I. with frontage on it, and St Cecilia Catholic Elementary School which is adjacent. There is also access to a sports field off of this portion of the street. Jennings Ave Jennings Avenue, which is a no exit street that runs off of Clendenan Avenue, south of Annette…
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Directed Transportation Services to reduce the speed limit on the following roads in Ward 13 to 30 km/hr: a. Clendenan Avenue from Annette Street to Glendowynne Road b. Jennings Avenue c. Evelyn Avenue from Annette Street to Woodside Avenue d. Weatherell Street, between Jane Street and Armadale Avenue e. Glenlake Avenue from Oakmount Road to Keele Street f. Althea Road g. Doran Avenue
